errors.evidence: The description of the y-axis tick labels is incomplete. It lists '4, 10, 40, 100, 400, 1k, 2k' but omits the visible ticks at '20' and '200'.
The description incorrectly identifies the color for MongoDB as 'dark blue' (тъмносиня), when it is clearly purple in the figure and legend.
The description states that PostgreSQL's score reaches 'about 400' in 2020, but the line is visibly well above the 400 mark, closer to 500.
The description states that MongoDB's score reaches 'about 300' in 2020, which is a significant underestimate. The line ends just below the 400 mark, approximately at 380-390.
The description states that IBM Db2 starts at 'about 150' in 2013. The line actually starts visibly higher, closer to 180, just below the 200 mark.
The description claims the SQLite line starts at 'about 40' in 2013, but the graph shows it starting much higher, at approximately 80-90.
The description incorrectly identifies the color for Cassandra as 'light green' (светлозелена), when the line in the figure and legend is cyan/light blue.
The description states the Cassandra line starts at 'about 20' in 2013, but the graph shows it starting higher, at approximately 40.
